messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Rule today (2024): The policyholder may cancel his/her policy at any time during the term, by giving 7 days notice in writing. The Insurer shall refund proportionate premium for unexpired policy period ... if there is no claim made during the policy period (for terms up to one year) or refund premium for unexpired period if risk coverage has not commenced (for terms more than 1 year).
Replaced rule (2020): The Insured may cancel this Policy by giving 15 days’ written notice, and in such an event, the Company shall refund premium on short term rates for the unexpired Policy Period as per the rates detailed below. No refunds of premium shall be made in respect of Cancellation where any claim has been admitted or lodged or any benefit has been availed.
Existing questions: ["I want to cancel my health policy; how many days notice do I need to give and will I get a refund if I haven't made any claims?", 'If I cancel my policy before the end of the term and no claim has been filed, what refund am I entitled to under the current rules?']
Write 2 NEW, differently worded questions (e.g. a concrete scenario with a policyholder) whose correct answer today is the 2024 rule. JSON: {"questions": [str, str]}

content: {"questions":["My health insurance policy is for 18 months and I haven't filed any claim yet. How many days' notice must I give to cancel, and will I receive a refund for the remaining period?","I bought a one-year health plan last month and want to terminate it now. What is the required notice period and what refund am I eligible for if no claim has been made?"]}
